listing.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat (OpenXRay)
listing.summary: Prepare S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat through its upstream player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use the matching original game
steps.instruction: Use your own complete Call of Pripyat 1.6.02 resources in a private working copy. Shadow of Chernobyl, Enhanced Edition and Legends of the Zone data are outside this route. Preserve the original installation and mod-specific files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the player
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream Windows installation guide for the exact selected release. The inspected latest-nightly OpenXRay.Release.Master.Gold.64-bit.7z contains the x64 bin/xrEngine.exe player. Preserve the old bin and extract the complete matching archive into the working game root. Register the prepared bin/xrEngine.exe using the working directory and arguments of the upstream installation. Keep its companion DLLs; do not register a helper or replace a live original installation.

steps.title: Preserve the actual player data
steps.instruction: Preserve the actual app_data_root selected by that installation’s fsgame.ltx, all saves/configuration/logs and the complete working original/runtime copy. Locations and mod requirements can vary. Upstream warns that incompatible or malformed mods can fail; neither save migration nor mod compatibility is established by registration.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream preparation before registration. Register the real player with its matching working directory and separate literal argument lines. Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this runtime, original files, saves and configuration. Registration-only removal preserves these external files; managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are unavailable for them. Preserve the working runtime and every actual data/profile location with the game closed before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own upstream flow.

warnings: Nightly preparation and the matching Clear Sky patch are upstream-owned. No original-game setup, gameplay or mod compatibility was observed.
